texts.1b876d808c6a:
Re-use statement:
To distribute, collect, process and submit PROMS questionnaires.

Aims:
Update to demographic data prior to supplier sending out pre and post op questionnaires

Method: 
List cleaning; this may be requested in two phases the first to complete NHS No’s the second to identify the deceased and provide latest address information for the living.  There are no restrictions for this to be processed as a single file run.

Permissions:
The organisation are a PROMs accredited Supplier and hold a valid and up to date PROMs sub-license (issued by the Department of Health).  The PROMs sub-licence prcess is overseen by the PROMs team (Giles Foster) and checked on an annual basis.  Giles Foster has confirmed accreditation is still in place.  The PROMs supplier must complete the NHS Information Governance Toolkit (IGT) on an annual basis and attain/retain Level 2 compliance (confirmed by Giles Foster).
